modules.title: 报名表、API 和数据库怎样共同完成一次保存
集成测试主要看连接处

items.title: 连接处会产生独有问题
items.text: 前端写 `startDate`、服务端却等 `start_date`，两个单元各自可能都正常，但接起来就失败。集成测试用真实或受控的相邻模块，检查请求、响应和数据格式是否一致。

items.title: 错误也要走完整条连接
items.text: 服务端拒绝无效报名时，页面应显示可理解的原因。只确认成功写入不够，还要确认失败信息能从服务端回到正确界面位置。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 集成测试不等于让整个产品都跑一遍。它选定需要协作的模块和依赖；从浏览器入口走到最终用户可见结果的完整流程，则是端到端测试。

lessonPractice.title: 价格计算单元测试都通过，但提交表单后总价显示为空。下一步最符合集成测试思路的是？

options.label: 提交表单，核对发出的总价字段、API 返回字段和页面读取字段是否一致
options.feedback: 对。每个小单元可能各自正确，问题常出在它们交接的数据约定。

options.label: 继续给价格计算函数增加输入组合，确认它单独运行时仍能返回总价
options.feedback: 这会继续加强单元测试，却没有检查总价在表单、API 和页面之间是否正确传递。

options.label: 从浏览器完成一次真实支付，只检查最终订单确认页有没有金额
options.feedback: 完整用户流程能证明结果，但范围更大；当前已有单元证据，先检查相邻模块的字段交接更容易定位。

en.title: Price unit tests pass, but the total is blank after form submission. What best follows integration-test thinking?

options.label: Submit the form and check that its total field, the API response field, and the page field agree
options.feedback: Correct. Each small unit may be right on its own; the data contract at their handoff is often wrong.

options.label: Add more input combinations to the price function and confirm it still returns a total on its own
options.feedback: That strengthens the unit test but does not check whether the total moves correctly through the form, API, and page.

options.label: Complete a real payment in the browser and only check whether the final confirmation page has an amount
options.feedback: A full user flow can prove the result, but its scope is wider. With unit evidence already available, checking the adjacent handoffs will locate the issue faster.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请做一次报名保存的集成测试：检查表单请求字段、API 接收和返回字段、数据库写入，以及服务端错误能否显示在表单上。改完后给我成功和无效输入各一次的结果。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Run an integration test for registration saving: check form request fields, API input and response fields, database write, and whether server errors appear on the form. Report one valid and one invalid-input result afterward.

learning.assumes: You know a page, API, and database can divide one save operation.
learning.outcome: You can see a cross-module failure as a reason to inspect connections, fields, and data transfer rather than only one function.

modules.title: How a form, API, and database save together

items.title: Handoffs create unique failures
items.text: A page can send `startDate` while a server expects `start_date`; each unit may work alone but fail together. Integration tests check requests, responses, and formats across neighboring modules.

items.title: Errors travel through the connection too
items.text: When the server rejects a registration, the page should show a useful reason. Checking only a successful write misses whether failure information reaches the right interface.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: An integration test is not running the whole product. It selects cooperating modules and dependencies; a full journey from browser entry to a visible result is an end-to-end test.

distinctions.label: End-to-end test
distinctions.text: An {c:integration-test} focuses on the connection between selected modules. An {c:e2e-test} drives the whole system from a user entry point to a visible result.
